about: Golden matrix for the UI plan (schema rpg-factory.ui-plan/1). tests/ui-skill-routing.test.sh runs each case as `python3 -B scripts/factory-cmd.py <verb> --json [args...] <request>` in a fixture workspace that holds the client repo (workspace 'full') or no client repo (workspace 'no-client'). `{client}` in args is the fixture client path. expect.skills is the exact ordered list; not_loaded_contains and missing_items are checked when present (missing_items: exact set of missing[].item; missing_contains: subset; missing_excludes: none of them). `{outside}` (args and request) is an existing Unity project folder outside the workspace. next_contains / next_excludes: substrings of the joined next steps; lead_route: exact lead.route.
